newsitem.title: THAILAND: IFCT Finance and Securities to make rights issue.
newsitem.headline: IFCT Finance and Securities to make rights issue.

text.p: IFCT Finance and Securities said on Thursday it aimed to raise 700 million baht through a 70 million share rights issue.
In a statement to the Stock Exchange of Thailand, the firm said existing shareholders will be offered one new share for each existing share at 10 baht par value.
The statement said the firm's board had resolved on Thursday to increase the company's registered capital from 700 million baht to 1.4 billion baht.
The registration book will close at midday on June 2. Subscriptions will take place between June 19-20 and payments between June 23-25, the statement added.
Any shares left unsold will be offered to the firm's parent bank the Industrial Finance Corporation of Thailand.
IFCT Finance and Securities Plc shares ended the morning session on Thursday down 0.50 baht at 13 baht.
The company said it would use the money raised by the issue to support future expansion. ($1 = 26 baht)
